author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam builds a replica of one of the most interesting artifacts from the atomic age: the Demon Core sphere that was built by the Manhattan Project to be the fissile core of early atomic bomb testing. But it's not just the sphere that Adam is interested in--he builds his take on the strange mangesium boxes that were used to transport the plutonium cores. It's an epic build to recreate one of the most unique carrying cases to ever have been made. 

3D printed demon core case: https://www.printables.com/model/451707-plutonium-core-case
Other replica builds of the demon core box: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RFHQdXxLj8M
https://www.therpf.com/forums/threads/historical-prop-the-plutonium-carrying-box-for-the-fat-man-bomb.278641/

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Josh Self
